name: zefaro-video
description: Introduction, demo and promotion video for Zefaro, made with Remotion.

scripts.render: npm run render:youtube && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:feed
scripts.installer-art: remotion still InstallerSidebar out/sidebar.png && remotion still InstallerHeader out/header.png && powershell -NoProfile -File scripts/png-to-bmp.ps1 out/sidebar.png ../src-tauri/installer/sidebar.bmp && powershell -NoProfile -File scripts/png-to-bmp.ps1 out/header.png ../src-tauri/installer/header.bmp
